body.translated_text: <s>Āryatriskandhasūtra</s> (The Noble Sūtra of the Three Sections)
Herein is this confession of transgressions (<s>āpattideśanā</s>):

body.text: ahamevaṃnāmā buddhaṃ śaraṇaṃ gacchāmi / dharma śaraṇaṃ gacchāmi / saṃghaṃ śaraṇaṃ gacchāmi /
body.translated_text: I, [named thus], go for refuge to the <s>Buddha</s>. I go for refuge to the <s>Dharma</s>. I go for refuge to the <s>Saṅgha</s>.

body.text:
namaḥ (bhagavate) śākyamunaye tathāgatāyārhate samyaksaṃbuddhāya / namo vajra(sāra)pramardine / namo ratnārciṣe / namo nāgeśvararājāya / namo vīrasenāya / namo vīranandine / namo ratnāgnaye / namo ratnacandraprabhāya / namo 'moghadarśine / namo ratnacandrāya / namo nirmalāya / namaḥ śūradattāya / namo brahmaṇe / namo brahmadattāya / namo varūṇāya / namo varuṇadevāya / namo bhadraśriye / namaścandanaśriye / namo 'nantaujase / namaḥ prabhāsaśriye / namo 'śokaśriye / namo nārāyaṇāya / namaḥ kusumaśriye / namo brahmajyotirvikrīḍitābhijñāya tathāgatāya / namaḥ padmajyotirvikrīḍitābhijñāya tathāgatāya / namo ghanaśriye / namaḥ smṛtiśriye / namaḥ suparikīrtitanāmadheyaśriye / nama indraketudhvajarājāya / namaḥ suvikrāntaśriye / namaḥ suvijitasaṃgrāmāya /
namo vikrāntagāmine / namaḥ samantāvabhāsavyūhaśriye / namo ratnapadmavikrāmiṇe / namo ratnapadmasupratiṣṭhitaśailendrarājāya tathāgatāyārhate samyaksaṃbuddhāya /
body.translated_text: Homage to the Blessed One <s>Śākyamuni</s>, the <s>Tathāgata</s>, the <s>Arhat</s>, the Perfectly Enlightened One. Homage to <s>Vajrasārapramardin</s>. Homage to <s>Ratnārcis</s>. Homage to <s>Nāgeśvararāja</s>. Homage to <s>Vīrasena</s>. Homage to <s>Vīranandin</s>. Homage to <s>Ratnāgni</s>. Homage to <s>Ratnacandraprabha</s>. Homage to <s>Amoghadarśin</s>. Homage to <s>Ratnacandra</s>. Homage to <s>Nirmala</s>. Homage to <s>Śūradatta</s>. Homage to <s>Brahman</s>. Homage to <s>Brahmadatta</s>. Homage to <s>Varuṇa</s>. Homage to <s>Varuṇadeva</s>. Homage to <s>Bhadraśrī</s>. Homage to <s>Candanaśrī</s>. Homage to <s>Anantaujas</s>. Homage to <s>Prabhāsaśrī</s>. Homage to <s>Aśokaśrī</s>. Homage to <s>Nārāyaṇa</s>. Homage to <s>Kusumaśrī</s>. Homage to <s>Tathāgata</s> <s>Brahmajyotirvikrīḍitābhijña</s>. Homage to <s>Tathāgata</s> <s>Padmajyotirvikrīḍitābhijña</s>. Homage to <s>Ghanaśrī</s>. Homage to <s>Smṛtiśrī</s>. Homage to <s>Suparikīrtitanāmadheyaśrī</s>. Homage to <s>Indraketudhvajarāja</s>. Homage to <s>Suvikrāntaśrī</s>. Homage to <s>Suvijitasaṃgrāma</s>. Homage to <s>Vikrāntagāmin</s>. Homage to <s>Samantāvabhāsavyūhaśrī</s>. Homage to <s>Ratnapadmavikrāmin</s>. Homage to <s>Ratnapadmasupratiṣṭhitaśailendrarāja</s>, the <s>Tathāgata</s>, the <s>Arhat</s>, the Perfectly Enlightened One.

body.text: evaṃpramukhā yāvantaḥ daśadikṣu sarvalokadhātuṣu tathāgatāarhantaḥ samyaksaṃbuddhāstiṣṭhanti dhriyante yāpayanti, te māṃ samanvāharantu buddhā bhagavantaḥ / yanmayā asyāṃ jātau anyāsu vā jātiṣu anavarāgre jātisaṃsāre saṃsaratā pāpakaṃ karma kṛtaṃ syātkāritaṃ vā kriyamāṇaṃ vā anumoditaṃ bhavet, staupikaṃ vā sāṃghikaṃ vā dravyamapahṛtaṃ syāt, hāritaṃ vā hriyamāṇaṃ vā anumoditaṃ bhavet / pancānantaryāṇi kṛtāni syuḥ kāritāni vā kriyamāṇāni vā anumoditāni bhaveyuḥ / daśākuśalān karmapathān samādāya vartitaṃ syāt, pare vā samādāpitāḥ syurvartamānā vā anumoditā bhaveyuryena karmāvaraṇenāvṛto 'haṃ nirayaṃ vā gaccheyaṃ tiryagyoniṃ vā yamaviṣayaṃ vā gaccheyaṃ pratyantajanapadeṣu mleccheṣu vā pratyājāyeyaṃ dīrghāyuṣkeṣu deveṣūpapadyeyamindriyavikalatāṃ vādhigaccheyaṃmithyādṛṣṭiṃ vopagṛhṇīyāṃ buddhotpādaṃ vā virāgayeyam, tatsarvaṃkarmāvaraṇaṃ teṣāṃ buddhānāṃ bhagavatāṃ jñānabhūtānāṃ cakṣurbhūtānāṃ sākṣibhūtānāṃ pramāṇabhūtānāṃ jānatāṃ paśyatamagrataḥ pratideśayāmi, āviṣkaromi na praticchādayāmi, āyatyāṃ saṃvaramāpadye /
body.translated_text: Beginning with these, as many <s>Tathāgatas</s>, <s>Arhats</s>, Perfectly Enlightened Ones as dwell, abide, and sustain themselves in all world-realms of the ten directions — may those <s>Buddhas</s>, the Blessed Ones, attend to me. Whatever evil <s>karma</s> I, wandering in the beginningless cycle of births in this birth or in other births, may have done, caused to be done, or being done, or may have rejoiced in; whatever property belonging to a <s>stūpa</s> or to the <s>Saṅgha</s> may have been stolen, caused to be stolen, or being stolen, or rejoiced in; whatever five acts of immediate retribution (<s>pañcānantarya</s>) may have been committed, caused to be committed, or being committed, or rejoiced in; whatever ten unwholesome courses of action (<s>daśākuśalakarmapatha</s>) may have been adopted and followed, or others may have been led to adopt, or those being followed may have been rejoiced in — by which karmic obscuration (<s>karmāvaraṇa</s>) I, being veiled, might go to hell, or to an animal birth, or to the realm of <s>Yama</s>, or be reborn among border peoples or barbarians, or be reborn among long-lived gods, or attain deficiency of faculties, or take up wrong views, or be averse to the arising of a <s>Buddha</s> — all that karmic obscuration, before those <s>Buddhas</s>, the Blessed Ones, who are embodiments of knowledge, embodiments of sight, witnesses, and authorities, who know and see, I confess, I reveal and do not conceal, and I undertake restraint for the future.

body.text: samanvāharantu māṃ te buddhā bhagavanto yanmayā asyāṃ jātāvanyāsu vā jātiṣvanavarāgre vā jātisaṃsāre saṃsaratā dānaṃ dattaṃ bhavedantaśastiryagyonigatāyāpyālopaḥ, śīlaṃ vā rakṣitaṃ bhaved yacca me brahmacaryavāsakuśalamūlam, yacca me sattvaparipākakuśalamūlam, yacca me bodhicittakuśalam, yacca me 'nuttarajñānakuśalamūlam, tatsarvamaikadhyaṃ piṇḍayitvā tulayitvā abhisaṃkṣipya anuttarāyāṃ samyaksaṃbodhau uttarottarayā (gurugurūṇā) pariṇāmanayā, yathā pariṇāmitamatītairbuddhairbhagavabhdiryathā pariṇāmayiṣyantyanāgatā buddhā bhagavantaḥ, yathā pariṇāmayanti etarhi daśasu dikṣu pratyutpannā buddhā bhagavantaḥ tathā hamapi pariṇāmayāmi /
body.translated_text: May those <s>Buddhas</s>, the Blessed Ones, attend to me. Whatever gift I, wandering in the beginningless cycle of births in this birth or in other births, may have given — even a morsel to an animal; whatever morality I may have kept; whatever root of virtue from living the holy life (<s>brahmacaryavāsa</s>); whatever root of virtue from maturing sentient beings; whatever virtue from the mind of awakening (<s>bodhicitta</s>); whatever root of virtue from unsurpassed knowledge — all that, having gathered, weighed, and collected together, I dedicate toward unsurpassed perfect awakening (<s>anuttarā samyaksaṃbodhi</s>) with the highest and most exalted dedication, just as the past <s>Buddhas</s>, the Blessed Ones, have dedicated, just as the future <s>Buddhas</s>, the Blessed Ones, will dedicate, and just as the <s>Buddhas</s>, the Blessed Ones, presently existing in the ten directions dedicate — so do I also dedicate.

body.text: sarva pāpaṃ pratideśayāmi / sarvaṃ puṇyamanumodayāmi / sarvān buddhānadhyeṣyāmi / bhavatu me jñānamanuttaram //
body.translated_text: I confess all evil. I rejoice in all merit. I entreat all <s>Buddhas</s>. May I attain unsurpassed knowledge.

body.text: ye cābhyatītāstathapi ca ye anāgatā ye cāpi tiṣṭhanti narottamā jināḥ / anantavarṇān guṇasāgaropamānupaimi sarvān śaraṇaṃ kṛtāñjaliḥ //
body.translated_text: Those who have passed beyond, and those yet to come, and those who abide — the supreme among men, the Victorious Ones — of infinite praise, like oceans of virtues, I approach them all for refuge with joined palms.
(The noble <s>Triskandha Mahāyāna Sūtra</s> (Sūtra of the Three Aggregates) is completed.)
